SCI-FLT-FIXED v0.1 — FINAL MICRO-REPAIR
AND CONDITIONAL-FREEZE DIRECTIVE

The SCI-FLT-FIXED r0.4 scientific architecture and all substantive scientific
dispositions are accepted as the basis for the freeze candidate.

Do not perform another broad scientific derivation.

Preserve:

- SCI-FLT-FIXED as the package;
- FLT-FIXED-CONV as the sole base numerical family;
- FLT-FIXED-CONV-LOWPASS only as a qualified subtype;
- strict real-valued linearity with no additive term;
- one sampled convolution applied exactly once;
- one exact parent signal role;
- one frozen parent membership and J_full;
- A_Theta,J = J_full L_Theta;
- K_req = K_nonzero for the ordinary method;
- exact-zero coefficients as nondependencies;
- K_store as scientifically nonauthoritative;
- full-footprint-only as the sole v0.1 edge method;
- explicit identity and zero-operator support;
- the empty-nonzero-support not-produced disposition;
- separate MAP-observation, MAP-coadd, and JINC parent roles;
- no filter/coadd commutation claim;
- transformed parent-map amplitude and inherited nominal-beam lineage;
- no automatic filtered-beam, flux, source-amplitude, or calibration claim;
- separately typed response families;
- covariance-authority and representation axes;
- the one-sparse marginal-only covariance result;
- immutable FLT-NOI-COMPATIBILITY;
- late independently requested NOI children;
- separate bundle, parent-row, and publication policy domains;
- candidate-before-realization lifecycle;
- exposure lineage distinct from influence;
- prospective numerical-comparison policy;
- every existing exclusion and nonclaim.

Do not inspect implementation, configuration, schemas, tests, audits, repairs,
validation, reductions, generated products, defaults, historical behavior, or
production status.

Do not renumber SCI-FLT-FIXED-REQ-001--053 or
SCI-FLT-FIXED-PRED-001--030.

Amend existing draft wording where the obligation already exists. Append new
identifiers only for genuinely new normative obligations.

======================================================================
1. TYPE THE PARENT FACT DOMAIN AND NUMERICAL SIGNAL DOMAIN
======================================================================

The current text calls m real-valued while also asking whether m_q is available
and finite.

Define separately:

    S_parent_fact
      = exact parent row-identity and fact domain;

    D_m
      = {q in S_parent_fact:
           an available finite real signal payload exists at q};

    m : D_m -> R.

A missing, unavailable, or non-finite stored payload is a typed row fact and is
not an element of the scientific numerical function m.

Define the ordinary output domain as:

    S_out
      = {p:
           for every r in K_req,
             p-r is in S_parent_fact,
             p-r is admitted for the exact FLT use,
             p-r is in D_m,
             and every required predicate passes}.

Define:

    y : S_out -> R.

Do not evaluate m_q before establishing q in D_m.

Parent-shaped storage remains a representation containing payload and state
records; it is not the scientific vector domain.

Update:

- the scientific-object definition;
- the same-grid operator;
- S_in/S_out terminology;
- the selector definition;
- REQ-002, REQ-007, REQ-012, REQ-037, and REQ-038 as needed;
- the rationale and ECS.

Append one requirement and prediction only if this cannot be expressed through
the existing clauses without changing their stable meaning.

======================================================================
2. TYPE THE ZERO OPERATOR WITHOUT OVERLOADING K_req
======================================================================

For the exact zero operator use:

    K_nonzero_zero = empty set
    K_req_zero     = empty set.

Do not describe a parent row domain as a K_req domain.

Define the zero-operator output domain independently:

    S_out_zero
      = exact admitted finite parent-signal row domain
        under the zero-operator request and predicates;

    y_p = 0 for p in S_out_zero.

The zero operator:

- does not acquire arbitrary storage rows through a vacuous universal
  predicate;
- retains exact parent identity and row support;
- has local fixed-state derivative zero;
- has parent-payload conditional covariance contribution zero;
- may still have unavailable complete source-domain response or systematic
  uncertainty.

Define “nonzero convolution” exactly as:

    K_nonzero is not empty.

Retain its distinction from a nonzero convolution having empty S_out.

======================================================================
3. SEPARATE SCIENTIFIC OPERATOR IDENTITY FROM STORAGE REPRESENTATION
======================================================================

The r0.4 text says K_store is scientifically nonauthoritative and that dense,
sparse, cropped, or zero-padded encodings do not change product identity.
It also binds K_store inside operator records and states broadly that operator
or kernel changes create new scientific generations.

Create two exact identity layers.

A. Scientific operator identity

Bind:

- canonical coordinate-domain offset-to-coefficient relation;
- canonical exact coefficient values and units;
- K_geom_science;
- K_nonzero;
- K_req;
- center, orientation, handedness, phase, and subpixel convention;
- normalization;
- coordinate/WCS metric;
- transfer qualification;
- edge rule;
- input and output scientific domains;
- support, response, covariance, and lifecycle science.

Its digest must be independent of dense/sparse/container serialization.

B. Representation identity

Bind separately:

- K_store;
- dense, sparse, cropped, or padded encoding;
- field ordering;
- byte serialization;
- compression/container representation;
- representation digest and representation generation.

A representation-only change:

- may create a new representation artifact or representation generation;
- must retain the same scientific operator identity;
- must retain the same FLT product identity and scientific generation;
- must not alter S_out, arithmetic, response, covariance, influence, or claim.

A change to the canonical scientific coefficient map or another scientific
operator fact creates a new FLT transformation and product generation.

Repair:

- Section 5 operator identity;
- Section 6 support identities;
- Section 10 generation identity;
- REQ-009, REQ-030, and REQ-038;
- PRED-009 and PRED-022;
- ECS reconstruction and mutation checks.

Add an exact representation-invariance fixture:

    dense and sparse encodings
    -> different representation identity
    -> identical scientific operator and FLT product identity.

======================================================================
4. CLOSE THE EMPTY-SUPPORT PUBLICATION OBJECT AND FOUR AXES
======================================================================

The ordinary lifecycle currently requires a complete_publication_candidate,
while the empty-S_out branch goes directly from
applied_no_scientific_output_support to publication_decision.

Introduce an exact candidate object for the no-product branch.

Preferred structure:

    complete_publication_disposition_candidate

with variants:

    product_candidate
    no_output_support_candidate.

The no-output-support candidate shall contain:

- exact request;
- parent;
- plan;
- operator;
- K_req;
- attempted output-domain construction;
- proof that S_out is empty;
- exact row/cause accounting;
- application generation;
- applied_no_scientific_output_support state;
- prescribed publication cause.

It contains no realized FLT-SIG and is not an atomic FLT product bundle.

SCI-FLT-FIXED:output_publication@1 shall evaluate either exact candidate
variant.

For a requested nonzero convolution with empty S_out, use the exact
publication-use axes:

    request       = requested
    applicability = applicable
    eligibility   = ineligible
    realization   = not_produced
    cause         = no_full_footprint_output_rows.

The earlier input/application use may have been eligible and successfully
applied. The later publication named use is ineligible because no scientific
signal rows exist.

Do not call this:

- not requested;
- disabled;
- execution failure;
- decision unavailable;
- zero operator;
- realized empty product.

Update:

- Section 10 lifecycle;
- Section 11 policy semantics;
- REQ-028, REQ-033, REQ-048, and REQ-053;
- PRED-029;
- rationale and ECS.

======================================================================
5. PRESERVE LATE-NOI AND COVARIANCE CLOSURES
======================================================================

Retain without weakening:

- not_requested_at_FLT_publication as historical provenance only;
- later NOI child request/lifecycle ownership;
- no FLT mutation;
- exact compatible FLT boundary/profile requirement;
- exact one-sparse marginal result under marginal-only authority;
- two-or-more-parent unknown-cross-term unavailability;
- no inferred cross-row covariance or independence;
- separately typed zero parent-payload contribution.

No further NOI or covariance-family expansion is authorized.

======================================================================
6. COMPLETE AUTHORITY AND SOURCE CLOSURE
======================================================================

Return the exact bytes of:

- the original seventeen-object Stage A packet;
- AUTHOR_PACKET_MANIFEST.md;
- all r0.2, r0.3, and r0.4 owner directives;
- MAP-to-FLT boundary;
- JINC-to-FLT boundary;
- FLT-to-NOI boundary;
- input_bundle_admission profile;
- input_parent_row_admission profile;
- output_publication profile;
- numerical-comparison policy;
- TRACEABILITY.json;
- BUILD_BINDING.json;
- AUTHORITY_MANIFEST.json;
- source-closure report;
- owner-decision parity report;
- core/view parity report;
- semantic-change report;
- profile report;
- clean-rebuild report;
- visual-QA and metadata report;
- every source document and rendered PDF.

Reproduce every quoted SHA-256 and byte count.

AUTHORITY_MANIFEST.json shall be the single proposed-freeze entry point. It
shall bind every object's:

- exact path;
- byte count;
- SHA-256;
- scientific/process/representation role;
- authority state;
- compatibility or supersession state;
- generated-view relation.

The three FLT policy records remain unregistered draft policies until separately
owner-approved and Registry-bound. Conditional scientific freeze does not make
them evaluable or make a numerical route available.

Any unreproducible object or binding returns only its dependent claim or route
to typed unavailability.

======================================================================
7. FREEZE-CANDIDATE DISPOSITION
======================================================================

After the formal repairs and exact source closure, return a proposed
scientific-owner freeze record for:

    SCI-FLT-FIXED v0.1.

The freeze shall be explicitly conditional.

It may establish:

- the fixed-convolution scientific method;
- exact product, response, covariance, support, lifecycle, and boundary
  meanings;
- exact typed unavailable routes.

It shall not establish:

- an available numerical MAP or JINC parent;
- registered FLT profiles;
- implementation conformity;
- numerical adequacy;
- response or covariance fidelity;
- validation;
- observational performance;
- readiness;
- production suitability;
- production authorization;
- SCI-FLT-INF authority;
- Unity activity.

Do not launch SCI-FLT-INF.

    SCI-FLT-FIXED-PRED-001--030.

If new independent obligations are required, use:

    SCI-FLT-FIXED-REQ-054 and later
    SCI-FLT-FIXED-PRED-031 and later.

Verify:

- one byte-identical final normative core in all views;
- one owner-decision state;
- exact equation/requirement/prediction parity;
- profile/action parity;
- source and manifest digests;
- no stale r0.1--r0.4 identity in the intended freeze candidate;
- all PDFs reopen and render without clipping, overlap, malformed glyphs, or
  broken identifiers;
- title, owner, revision, date, status, and metadata agree.
